div.head: II Cn 37
div.ab: And gyf hwa on leasre gewitnesse openlice stande ⁊ he oferstæled weorðe, ne stande his gewitnes syððan for aht, ac gylde þam cingce oððe landrican (þe his socne ahe) be healsfange.
And gif hwa on leasre gewitnysse openlice stande ⁊ he ofersteled weorðe, ne stande his gewitnesse siððan for naht, ac gilde þam cyninge oððe landrican be hal[s]fangce.
Si quis in mendaci testimonio manifeste stabit et probatus inde fuerit, non admittatur deinceps in legitimum testimonium, sed soluat regi uel terrę domino suum healsfang.
Be leasre gewitnesse. And gyf hwa on leasre gewitnysse openlice stande ⁊ he oferstæled wurðe, ne stande his gewitnysse syððan for naht, ac gylde ðam cynge oððe landrican be halsfange.

Concerning false witness. And if anyone has given testimony which is manifestly false, and is convicted thereof, his testimony henceforth shall be valueless, and he shall pay to the king or to the lord of the manor a sum equivalent to his healsfang.

(Von falschem Zeugniss. B) Und wenn jemand notorisch in falschem Zeugniss auftritt, und er [dessen dann] überführt wird, so gelte sein Zeugniss ferner für nichts, sondern er zahle dem König oder dem Grundherrn (der über ihn Gerichtsbarkeit besitzt G) [eine Summe gemäss seinem] Halsfang.

(Of false witness. B) And if anyone openly stands in false witness and is [then] convicted, let his witness count for nothing thereafter, but let him pay the king or the landlord (who has jurisdiction over him, G) [an amount equal to] his healsfang.
div.note: G's ‘aht’ for ‘naht’ (the other MSS; II As 10.1). G's ‘(þe his socne ahe)’ is missing from the others and not original (as in 63). Liebermann compares II As 10.1.
